messages:
Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone for joining — quick post-AH thread to capture Qs that need owners and short clarifications.
Mike Chen: TL;DR of ask: performance targets for MLP crop model—are we still shipping 99th p95 < 120ms by end of Q2? @stephanie
Stephanie Ortiz: Confirming target is p95 < 120ms for hosted endpoints under standard load, yes. Dedicated SLA separate — pinging infra.
Raj Singh: For Dedicated, we should clarify if that SLA includes autoscale warmup. Right now our SLA assumes pre-warmed pools.
Stephanie Ortiz: Correct — Dedicated SLA assumes configured reserved capacity. Action: @Raj to propose wording for SLA page by Friday.
Julia Park: Action item: consolidate links mentioned in AH slides. I started a doc: https://internal.redwood/ah/q2-links — please add any follow-ups.
Sam Rivera: Question from sales: can we provide a simple blurb comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for procurement? Short 2‑para for contracts.
Aisha Patel: Yes — @Sam draft a 2-paragraph summary and I'll loop in legal for review. Due Tue COB.
Mike Chen: Small clarif: optimizer recommendations in Optimize — will it auto-apply quantization or just suggest? @stephanie
Stephanie Ortiz: Optimize will only suggest and estimate cost/quality impact; auto-apply behind explicit opt-in. We will add this to the FAQ.
EngAllHandsBot: (note) Recording and slides uploaded: https://internal.redwood/ah/recording-1999991234
Raj Singh: Owner assignments: Raj -> SLA wording, Sam -> procurement blurb, Julia -> link doc maintenance, Stephanie -> FAQ update; Aisha -> synthesize and send to execs.
Aisha Patel: I'll send a one-pager to execs by EOD Thursday with owners and deadlines. If anyone wants to opt out or reassign, @me now.
Mike Chen: tiny: typo on slide 7 latency table — 'p95' shows as 'p9s'. @Julia can you fix before share?
Julia Park: noted, fixed. Updated doc link.
Sam Rivera: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
